note: Share of years with the event in that month. Weather comes from one grid cell (about 10 km for IMERG, 50 km for MERRA-2): the same value for every field of the farm. Thresholds are working values to be set with an agronomist.

hazards.label: Frost in the growing season (Tmin ≤ −2 °C)
hazards.definition: at least one day with minimum temperature ≤ −2 °C; shown for April–October

hazards.label: Deep cold (Tmin ≤ −20 °C)
hazards.definition: at least one day with minimum temperature ≤ −20 °C: winterkill risk for winter crops without snow

hazards.label: Heat (Tmax ≥ 30 °C, 3+ days)
hazards.definition: three or more days with maximum temperature ≥ 30 °C

hazards.label: Dry month (rain − evaporative demand, lowest fifth)
hazards.definition: monthly rain minus Hargreaves ET0 in the lowest fifth of that month over 2001–2025 and below −40 mm

hazards.label: Heavy rain (≥ 20 mm in a day)
hazards.definition: at least one day with 20 mm of rain or more

hazards.label: Wet spell (≥ 10 rain days of 1 mm+)
hazards.definition: ten or more days with at least 1 mm of rain: field work and harvest are delayed

sources: NASA POWER daily API (AG community): IMERG_PRECTOT (GPM IMERG), T2M_MIN, T2M_MAX (MERRA-2)
